legal_basis: Wildlife Conservation and Management Act 2013 (No.47 of 2013)
mandate_summary: Conserve and manage wildlife; enforce wildlife laws; manage national parks and protected areas; serve as Kenya's CITES Management Authority; conduct conservation education/research; issue all wildlife-related permits
laws_enforced: WCMA 2013; L.N.241/2017 (CITES Treaties); L.N.242/2017 (Endangered Species Regulations)
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide — all national parks, national reserves, wildlife on public/community/private land; territorial waters for marine wildlife
industries_regulated: Wildlife tourism; wildlife ranching; trophy hunting (moratorium in place); live wildlife trade; bioprospecting; film production in protected areas

parent_ministry: Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry
legal_basis: Forest Conservation and Management Act 2016 (No.34 of 2016)
mandate_summary: Manage all public forests; regulate commercial exploitation of forest resources; conserve forest biodiversity; enforce forest laws; issue permits for forest product trade/export
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide — all public forests (state and local authority); oversight role over community forests and private forests
industries_regulated: Timber industry; charcoal production; forest-based tourism; non-timber forest products; carbon markets; beekeeping in forests

parent_ministry: Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry
legal_basis: Environmental Management and Co-ordination Act 1999 (No.8 of 1999)
mandate_summary: Exercise general supervision and co-ordination over environmental management; set environmental standards; review Environmental Impact Assessments; regulate access to genetic resources; administer biodiversity regulations
laws_enforced: EMCA 1999; ABS Regulations 2006 (L.N.160/2006); ABS Regulations 2025 (L.N.19/2025); Biodiversity Regulations 2023
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide — all sectors and activities with environmental impact; national mandate over genetic resources
industries_regulated: All sectors — manufacturing; agriculture; mining; infrastructure; research institutions collecting biological/genetic resources

parent_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Co-operatives
legal_basis: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service Act No.54 of 2012 (reorganised from predecessor)
mandate_summary: Safeguard the quality and health of plants and plant products; prevent introduction and spread of plant pests and diseases; regulate importation and exportation of plants and seeds; administer Seeds and Plant Varieties Act and Plant Protection Act
laws_enforced: Seeds and Plant Varieties Act Cap.326; Plant Protection Act Cap.324; KEPHIS Act 2012
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide — all ports of entry; all agricultural and horticultural activities; plant material imports and exports
industries_regulated: Agriculture; horticulture; floriculture; seed industry; plant nurseries; research institutions working with plant material

parent_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Co-operatives
mandate_summary: Exercise general supervision and control over transfer, handling and use of GMOs; issue approvals for contained use, environmental release, import, export and transit of GMOs; advise government on biosafety matters
laws_enforced: Biosafety Act 2009; Biosafety (Contained Use) Regulations 2011; Biosafety (Environmental Release) Regulations 2011; Biosafety (Import, Export and Transit) Regulations 2011
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide — all institutions and persons handling GMOs
industries_regulated: Agricultural biotechnology; food and beverage industry; pharmaceutical industry; research institutions working with GMOs

parent_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Co-operatives
legal_basis: Fisheries Management and Development Act 2016 (No.35 of 2016)
mandate_summary: Regulate and manage fisheries resources; declare endangered fish species; manage Marine Protected Areas; regulate import/export of live fish; manage fishing gear standards
laws_enforced: FMDA 2016; Marine Fisheries Regulations 2024 (L.N.125/2024); Aquaculture Regulations 2024 (L.N.126/2024)
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide — inland water bodies (lakes, rivers, dams); territorial waters and Exclusive Economic Zone; EAC shared fisheries
industries_regulated: Fishing industry (artisanal and commercial); aquaculture; fish processing and export; live fish import/export

mandate_summary: Regulate and oversee safety, security and environmental standards in the maritime sector; prevent marine pollution; enforce shipping and environmental compliance in Kenyan waters
laws_enforced: KMA Act 2006; MARPOL (implementation); various maritime safety regulations
jurisdiction_scope: Kenya's territorial waters and maritime ports; Exclusive Economic Zone; inland waterways (jointly with county governments)
industries_regulated: Shipping industry; maritime transport; port operations; offshore oil and gas exploration; marine tourism

parent_ministry: The National Treasury and Economic Planning
mandate_summary: Enforce customs and tax laws at all ports, airports and border crossings; verify CITES permits for wildlife trade; interdict illegal wildlife trafficking; enforce import/export prohibitions
laws_enforced: East African Community Customs Management Act; Customs and Excise Act (Cap.472); CITES (enforcement role)
jurisdiction_scope: All official ports of entry — Mombasa, Nairobi (JKIA), Kisumu, Moyale, Namanga, Busia, Malaba, Lungalunga, Isebania and 60+ other border points
industries_regulated: All import/export trade including wildlife, plant material, seeds, genetic resources, live animals, trophies

parent_ministry: Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry
legal_basis: Forest Conservation and Management Act 2016 (advisory role); Science, Technology and Innovation Act 2013
mandate_summary: Conduct and coordinate forestry research; advise KFS and Cabinet Secretary on protected tree species; maintain forest germplasm bank; develop guidelines for sustainable forest management
laws_enforced: Advisory role under FCMA 2016 s.40 (protected tree species gazettement)
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide — forestry research stations and field sites; advisory role over all forests
industries_regulated: Forestry research; timber industry (advisory); conservation NGOs; academic institutions

legal_basis: Not statutory — registered under Societies Act
mandate_summary: Represent and support private and community wildlife conservancies; advocate for wildlife-friendly policies; coordinate with KWS on wildlife management outside protected areas
laws_enforced: Operates under WCMA 2013 framework for conservancies (ss.33–43)
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide — private ranches, community conservancies, and conservancy land outside national parks
industries_regulated: Private ranching and conservancy industry; tourism industry; community land management

institution_name: Kenya Marine and Fisheries Research Institute
parent_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Co-operatives
mandate_summary: Conduct research on marine and freshwater fisheries resources; advise KeFS on endangered fish species; monitor status of marine protected areas; provide scientific basis for fisheries management decisions
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide — marine research stations (Mombasa, Shimoni, Msambweni); Lake Victoria (Kisumu), Lake Turkana, Lake Naivasha
industries_regulated: Fishing industry; aquaculture; marine conservation; academic research

parent_ministry: State Department for Heritage and Culture
mandate_summary: National Museums and Heritage Act 2006 (No.6 of 2006)
laws_enforced: Collect, preserve and exhibit Kenya's natural and cultural heritage; curate Type specimens of Kenya endemic species; protect paleontological sites; issue permits for scientific collection of natural heritage items
url: Nationwide — museums, heritage sites, paleontological sites, natural history collections
column12: Museum and heritage tourism; academic and scientific research; paleontology and geology industries

parent_ministry: Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry
mandate_summary: Finance environmental conservation programmes; grant funding for biodiversity conservation; support NEMA and KFS programmes
industries_regulated: Conservation NGOs; research institutions; community groups involved in environmental management

parent_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Co-operatives
legal_basis: Veterinary Surgeons and Veterinary Para-professionals Act 2011; Animals (Control of Experiments) Act
mandate_summary: Regulate import/export of animals and animal products; enforce animal health standards; participate in biosafety authority; control diseases including zoonoses affecting wildlife
laws_enforced: Animals Act Cap.360; Animal Diseases Act Cap.364; Biosafety Act 2009 (co-enforcement)
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide — livestock and domestic animal sector; border enforcement of livestock imports/exports; advises on wildlife disease
industries_regulated: Livestock industry; veterinary industry; pet trade; zoo and aquarium industry; animal feed industry
